full_page.content:
1935, March 27
The following is a faithful transcription of the handwritten original by the Servant of God, Father Solanus Casey, O.F.M. Cap.
ST. BONAVENTURE'S MONASTERY 1780 Mt. Elliott Avenue Detroit, Mich.
Mar 27 1935
Mr. Wm Spring Yonkers. New York.
My Dear Willie: - Many thanks for favor just read. I am glad to know you are well and doing. Thank God for everything. I wish you would convey best wishes and blessings to all my friends you chance to meet in picturesque, beautiful Yonkers.
This has been the busiest place I been located in so far . . Near 31 years now since I went to Yonkers - and Willie was one of Fr. Stephan's boys.
-- God's blessings to all - - Fr. Solanus Casey O.M Cap.
Copy of card in possession of: Mr. William Spring 18 River Glen Hastings-on-Hudson, N.Y.
